svg.title: Stargate — Tor, I2P and Nym in your browser
svg.desc: A seven-chevron blue-water portal, clean Stargate lettering with small rings above the A letters, a soft underline, a subtle starfield, and a lilac Observatory-style planet with silver and champagne rings on the right. Static project artwork, not a connection-status indicator.
